visibility.label: Minimum visible role
visibility.help: Sets the minimum role that can view or download this folder/file. When unset, all members can view it.

download.disabledHelp: Hides the download button and refuses to issue download URLs. This is a deterrent only and cannot prevent browser viewing.

publicLink.title: Public link
publicLink.description: Share this file via a public link with people who are not signed in. View-only by default.
publicLink.downloadAllowedHelp: When on, this link allows downloads. If the file itself disallows downloads, that takes precedence.
publicLink.expiresHelp: A public link must have an expiry. You can set it up to 30 days ahead.
publicLink.adminOnly: Only admins and deputy admins can issue and manage public links.

errors.inactive: This shared link has been deactivated
errors.downloadNotAllowed: Download is not allowed for this shared link
errors.expiryInvalid: An expiry is required and can be at most 30 days ahead
